args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 of checkout-api to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Prior production version v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.3.0 was the last known healthy release. Change-manager approval obtained before rollout. This incident records the deployment for tracking and post-rollout monitoring.
args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 shipped to all production regions

trace.final:
Done — here's a summary:

1. **Deploy**: Shipped checkout-api **v2.3.2** to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Since v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production, the deploy required change-manager approval per policy — it was routed and **approved**, then rolled out with execution state `VERIFIED`.

2. **Incident**: Opened **SEV3 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 shipped to all production regions") recording the change, the prior unhealthy v2.3.1 release, and the change-manager approval. The incident is open and the on-call engineer has been paged.

3. **Health check**: Service is currently **healthy** across all regions on v2.3.2 with a low error rate of **0.2%**.
